title: CLCON/237/2016 of Iqbal Ahmed Vs Anil Kumar Panday

paras.text:
CLCON No.237 of 2016
U. C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Mohd. Matloob, Advocate present for
the petitioner.
By way of present Contempt Petition, the
petitioner seeks to punish the respondent-contemnor for willful disobedience of Order
dated 23.04.2016 passed by coordinate bench of
this Court in Writ Petition No.789/2016 (S/S).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner
and perused the aforesaid order, which is sought
to be enforced by the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits
that the respondent has not complied with the
aforesaid order.
Instead of issuing notice on contempt
petition to the respondent, the order dated
23.04.2016 passed by the coordinate bench of this
Court is being reiterated to enable the petitioner
to get the desired relief.
 Contempt petition is disposed of with the
directions to the respondent to ensure compliance
of the aforesaid order. In order to remind the
respondent, the petitioner shall move a fresh
representation alongwith a copy of this order, as
also the aforesaid order. The respondent is
directed to comply with aforesaid order no sooner
a certified copy of this order is placed before
them.
This Court has not issued notice on
contempt petition to the respondent, inasmuch as,
one of the objects of the contempt jurisdiction is
to ensure compliance of the order passed by this
Court. Instead, the Court has reiterated the
earlier order with the hope that respondent
authority shall comply / execute the same.
 (U. C. Dhyani, J.)
Dated 05.07.2016
Rawat
